announcements.text: Fujifilm Sonosite Inc., Bothell, Washington, has been awarded a maximum $957,714,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for ultrasound systems, components and accessories. This was a competitive acquisition with 25 responses received. This is a five-year base contract with one five-year option period. Other contracts are expected to be awarded under this solicitation (SPE2D1-26-R-0002) and awardees will compete for a portion of the maximum dollar value. The ordering period end date is Oct. 28, 2036. Using customers are Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps and federal civilian agencies. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2027 through 2032 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania (SPE2D1-27-D-0001).

announcements.text: MNBMcD Waterfront JV, Honolulu, Hawaii, is awarded a $249,000,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, architect-engineering contract for various waterfront projects and other projects primarily under the cognizance of Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC) Hawaii. This contract provides design and engineering services for waterfront projects. Work will be performed within the NAVFAC Hawaii AOR and is expected to be completed by October 2031. The maximum dollar value, including one 12-month base period and four 12-month option years, is $249,000,000. Fiscal 2027 operation and maintenance, Navy contract funds in the amount of $3,000 will be obligated at time of award to satisfy the minimum guarantee, and funds will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was competitively procured via SAM.gov website, with two offers received. NAVFAC, Hawaii, Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, Hawaii is the contracting activity (N62478-27-D-5050).

announcements.text: BAE Systems Maritime Solutions Jacksonville LLC, Jacksonville, Florida, was awarded a $66,526,423 firm-fixed-price contract action for maintenance, modernization and repair of USS St Louis (LCS 19) Fiscal 2027 Docking Selected Restricted Availability. The scope of this acquisition includes all labor, supervision, equipment, production, testing, facilities, and quality assurance necessary to prepare for and accomplish the Chief of Naval Operations Availability for critical modernization, maintenance, and repair programs. This contract includes options, which, if exercised, would bring the cumulative value of this contract to $80,693,639. Work will be performed in Mayport, Florida, and is expected to be completed by December 2027. Fiscal 2027 other procurement, (Navy) funds in the amount of $58,817,928 (88%); fiscal 2026 other procurement, (Navy) funds in the amount of $7,474,140 (11%); and fiscal 2025 other procurement, (Navy) funds in the amount of $234,355 (<1%), will be obligated at time of award. This contract was competitively procured using full and open competition via the System for Award (SAM) website, with two offers received. The Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity (N0002427C4405). (Awarded Oct. 28, 2026).

announcements.text: RTX Corp., Pratt & Whitney Military Engines, East Hartford, Connecticut, is awarded a $32,181,162 cost-plus-incentive-fee modification (P00009) to a previously awarded contract (N0001926C0112). This modification exercises an option to provide recurring sustainment support to include repair of repairables support for the F135 propulsion systems used in the F-35A conventional takeoff and landing and F-35C carrier variant aircraft in support of the F-35 Lightning II program in support of the Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, F-35 cooperative program partners, and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. Work will be performed in East Hartford, Connecticut (40%); Oklahoma City, Oklahoma (21%); Indianapolis, Indiana (12%); West Palm Beach, Florida (6%); Windsor Locks, Connecticut (6%); Brekstad, Norway (4%); Leeuwarden, Netherlands (3%); Iwakuni, Japan (3%); Williamtown, Australia (2%); Cameri, Italy (1%); Marham, United Kingdom (1%); and Fort Worth, Texas (1%), and is expected to be completed in November 2027. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance (Air Force) funds in the amount of $16,453,791; fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance (Navy) funds in the amount of $4,164,560; fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance (Marine Corps) funds in the amount of $1,612,425; F-35 cooperative program partner funds in the amount of $5,738,624; and FMS customer funds in the amount of $4,211,762 will be obligated at the time of award. This modification was not competitively procured. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Lyme Computer Systems Inc.,* Lebanon, New Hampshire, is awarded a $27,273,292 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract with firm-fixed-price ordering provisions for the procurement of brand-name Siemens RUGGEDCOM commercial-off-the-shelf, industrial-grade networking hardware, equipment, and components. Work will be performed in Lebanon, New Hampshire, and is expected to be completed by October 2033. Fiscal 2026 other procurement, (Navy) funds in the amount of $20,473 will be obligated with the first task order and will not expire at the end of the fiscal year. All other funding will be provided on individual orders as they are issued. This contract was competitively procured utilizing 10 U.S. Code 3204(a)(1) (limited number of responsible sources and no other supplies or services will satisfy agency requirements) limiting offerors to only authorized Siemens RUGGEDCOM brand-name resellers who are small businesses. Two offers were received via the SAM.gov website. Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, is the contracting activity (N6449827D0002).

announcements.text: The Boeing Co., St. Louis, Missouri, has been awarded a maximum $31,911,362 firm-fixed-price and cost-reimbursement contract for the NATO Airlift Management Programme (NAMP) C-17 customer logistics service. The Air Force Life Cycle Management Center, Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio, is the contracting activity (FA8621-27-C-B002).

announcements.text: Amentum Services Inc., Chantilly, Virginia, has been awarded a $27,301,761 modification (P00056) to previously awarded contract FA4890-22-C-0015 for Pacific Air Forces global prepositioned materiel services. This modification provides for the funding of option year five services to provide storage, maintenance, outload, reconstitution, exercise, and contingency logistics support of prepositioned materiel. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $177,443,754 from $150,141,992. Work will be performed at Joint Base Elmendorf-Richardson, Alaska; Holloman Air Force Base, New Mexico; Andersen AFB, Guam; and Misawa Air Base, Japan, and is expected to be completed by Oct. 31, 2027. Fiscal 2027 operation and maintenance funds in the amount of $27,301,761 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Combat Command, Acquisition Management and Integration Center, Langley Air Force Base, Virginia, is the contracting activity. (Awarded on Oct. 28, 2026).
